title: bought as a gift for a friend
text: bought as a gift for a friend. I bought this a gift for a friend who is part of a military family.  They live in texas right now and she was looking an alternative to popcicles.  She reports that this machine is awesome fun.  Uses regular ice cubes and is very easy to run!  I purchased extra paper cones, holders and flavorings. They are going to be the hit of the neighborhood this summer!  Will update if there are any issues.

product_metadata.title: Nostalgia Vintage Countertop Snow Cone Maker Makes 20 ICY Treats Includes 2 Reusable Plastic Cups & Ice Scoop
features: NOSTALGIA SNOW CONE KITS: Works perfectly with all Nostalgia snow cone kits - try the Snow Cone Kit, Snow Cone Syrups, or the Straws and Cups. Whether party time or snack time, this unit can hold up to 20 (8 oz) snow cones at a time.

STAINLESS STEEL CUTTING BLADES : The precision-cut stainless steel cutting blades work quickly and efficiently to shave ice cubes into delicious, fluffy snow-like ice. A safety switch is built into the shaving mechanism to keep hands safe

364 DEGREE VIEWS : With a chamber that's clear from all views, it's easy to shave ice and watch it pile up from any angle. Use the snow cone side shelf as a prepping station to hold 2 snow cones and add your favorite syrups
PERFECT SIZE : This ice shaver is the perfect size to fit on a kitchen countertop or a small side table, making it easy to serve snow cones wherever you go

description: Bring the party indoors and create a number of delicious and refreshing ice drinks. Precision-cut stainless steel cutting blades transform regular ice cubes into frozen treats that the whole family will love. Simply fill the top with ice cubes, secure the lid, and let the snow fly. Serve snow from the ice storage bin, and prepare them on the handy cone shelf with this wonderful countertop unit.
